data.name: PREDATORS
data.detailed_description:
YOU ARE NOT THE HUNTER

You wake inside a vast prehistoric arena with no memory of how you arrived.

Hidden somewhere within the trial is a puzzle standing between you and evacuation. Find the solution, reach the extraction point, and escape before the creature hunting you finds its next meal.

But survival is not enough.

The cameras are rolling. The audience is watching. And the Mesozoic Corporation expects a show.

SURVIVE THE TRIALS

Enter deadly multiplayer trials with up to three other players. Search the arena, solve its puzzle, and make your way to the evacuation point while a prehistoric predator stalks your every move.

Noise, panic, and one bad decision can turn a promising escape into a massacre.

Work together to survive, or leave someone behind when the situation becomes desperate.

FACE SIX DEADLY PREDATORS

Each trial unleashes one dinosaur from a roster of six unique predators.

Every species has its own behaviors, abilities, strengths, and hunting patterns. The strategy that saves you from one creature may get you killed by another.

Learn what is hunting you. Adapt to its behavior. Exploit its weaknesses. Or become its next victim.

ESCAPE IS ONLY THE BEGINNING

Complete the puzzle, reach evacuation, and escape the trial alive to increase your reputation.

The more entertaining your performance, the greater your name becomes. Climb the public leaderboards and prove that you are the greatest contestant the Mesozoic Corporation has ever placed inside the arena.

Everyone wants to be remembered. Most contestants are remembered for how they died.

SOMEBODY IS WATCHING

Cameras cover the arena. An unseen voice echoes through the tannoy. Somewhere beyond the walls, your fear is being broadcast as entertainment.

Why were you chosen?

Who is watching?

And what is the Mesozoic Corporation really hiding?

The truth is waiting at the end of the trials, but only the best entertainers will survive long enough to uncover it.

You have one life.
They have thousands of prisoners.
Make it count.

data.short_description: Welcome to the Jurassic arena. You are a prisoner, forced into life or death games against prehistoric dinosaurs for the entertainment of others with up to 3 friends. Enter the arena, solve the puzzle, live another day.
